BoringSSL-specific FFI declarations

These APIs are only available when compiling with -d:useBoringSSL. They provide fine-grained control over the TLS ClientHello for browser fingerprint impersonation (GREASE, extension permutation, cert compression, ALPS, etc.).

Expose the native SSL_CTX_set_grease_enabled binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_CTX_set1_groups_list binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_CTX_set_min_proto_version binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_CTX_set_max_proto_version binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_CTX_add_cert_compression_alg binding used by the TLS transport.Expose the native SSL_add_application_settings binding used by the TLS transport.
